_comment: Source interface strings. Every other language file uses the same keys. Placeholders in {braces} must be kept exactly.
site.tagline: What self-hosting actually costs, per tool, per team size.
site.description: Transparent cost comparisons between commercial SaaS and their self-hosted open-source alternatives. Every number is computed from a published sizing model and dated price sources.
home.title: {brand} - what self-hosting actually costs, per tool and team size
crumb.label: Breadcrumb
foot.legal: Prices are read from vendor pricing pages on the dates shown on each page and are not updated continuously. Check the vendor before you buy. Nothing here is financial advice.
lead.headline: Get the migration checklist for this tool
lead.subhead: A one-page pre-flight list: data export path, sizing, backup plan, and the rollback step most people skip.
affiliate.disclosure.digitalocean: The DigitalOcean link above is a referral link: if you sign up through it and pay your first $25, we receive $25 of DigitalOcean account credit. That never changes the computed costs, which server is chosen, or the conclusion of this page. The sizing model and every price source are published in full.
affiliate.disclosure.kamatera: The Kamatera link above is an affiliate link: if you open a paying account through it, Kamatera pays us a one-time commission of $75 (in most countries). That never changes the computed costs, which server is chosen, or the conclusion of this page. The sizing model and every price source are published in full.
affiliate.disclosure.other: The {provider} link above is a tracked affiliate link: if you sign up through it, we may earn a commission. That never changes the computed costs, which server is chosen, or the conclusion of this page. The sizing model and every price source are published in full.

idx.compare.description: {n} comparisons between commercial software and its self-hosted alternative, each priced from a published sizing model and dated vendor prices.
idx.compare.heading: Every comparison
idx.compare.lead: {n} paid products priced against their self-hosted alternatives at {size}. Anything tagged as paid-wins is a case where self-hosting costs more once your time is counted.
idx.tools.title: Every self-hosted tool we price ({year})
idx.tools.description: Self-hosted open-source tools with a published sizing model and a real monthly cost at every team size from one user to 250.
idx.tools.heading: Every tool we price
idx.tools.lead: Each tool has a sizing model, the cheapest server plan that fits it at each team size, and an honest estimate of the hours it takes to run. The badge is how heavy it is to operate.
idx.hosting.title: Hosting providers for self-hosting, and which prices we trust
idx.hosting.description: The hosting providers behind every cost figure on this site, which of their prices we have read ourselves, and which we have not.
idx.hosting.heading: Hosting providers
idx.hosting.lead: Every server cost on this site comes from a provider in this list. Only the ones marked as confirmed feed a published figure.
idx.hosting.note: A provider marked as unconfirmed has specifications we trust and prices we could not read programmatically. Rather than estimate, we leave it out of the maths and say so on its page.
